description: Skip project.toml read in makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn when the suggestion batch is empty.

userStories.title: Guard toml read behind non-empty candidates
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the suggestion-filing hook to skip the project.toml read and prefix/parent resolution when there are no candidates to file, so that empty batches avoid an unnecessary filesystem read while all-duplicate batches still emit their audit event.
acceptanceCriteria: In makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts), the parseToml(readProjectToml()) call, the issue_prefix resolution, the resolveIssueId(parentIssue) call, and the candidate-filing for-loop are all wrapped inside a candidates.length > 0 guard. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

When candidates is empty (candidates.length === 0), readProjectToml/parseToml is not called (verified by a test that injects a spawnFn/dedup path yielding zero candidates and asserts the toml reader is never invoked). [oracle: bun test]

The all-duplicates path (candidates empty, dupSkipped > 0) still emits the suggestion-filed logEvent with { filedIds: [], dupSkipped: N, failedCount: 0 }; the logEvent block remains OUTSIDE the guard. [oracle: bun test]
Non-empty candidates path is behaviorally unchanged: each candidate is filed with derivedFrom: [parentIssueId] when parentIssueId resolves. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/commands/sidecar.ts, function makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (~line 2242-2279). Wrap ONLY the toml read (config/prefix/parentIssueId) + the candidate for-loop inside `if (candidates.length > 0) { ... }`; declare filedIds/failedCount before the guard so the post-loop logEvent block (fires on filedIds.length>0 || dupSkipped>0 || failedCount>0) stays outside it. GOTCHA (from issue spec): never wrap the logEvent block, or the all-duplicates path stops emitting its event. GOTCHA: src-only change, no edit under templates/ or agents/, so no embed-vendor/byte-parity concern. Tests mirror source under test/; look for existing makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn coverage to extend.
